Liquids: templates are numbered samples? 12 samples. So sample_i for i=1..12. Buffer mix etc reagents.

Master mix components per reaction; we could treat individually, no pooling needed.

Thus plates map: group with 12 members each having those volumes.

Destination select auto.

No discarding.

Proceed.
